scope: native host-side device-provider port, supervisor quarantine registry, per-actor turn/fence integration

findings.issue: two progress workers could invoke physical provider release concurrently
findings.fix: exclusive Releasing phase before mutex unlock

findings.issue: cancellation during graceful provider release could cause a second release attempt
findings.fix: keep Retiring ownership until outcome; reuse release receipt on cancellation

findings.issue: two progress workers could concurrently reconcile same unknown enqueue
findings.fix: exclusive Reconciling phase and fail-closed restore on exception

findings.issue: malformed native provider reconciliation could leave device loan quarantined without escalating failure
findings.fix: escalate malformed receipt via device-loss HostFailure CONTROL and retain loan

findings.issue: process root pin preceded map entry reservation and could leak empty registry on allocation failure
findings.fix: reserve map slot first, then root pin inside rollback-protected construction
